ruling.reasoning:
The trip ran 30.0 km against an optimal 24.4 km, a deviation over 1 km, so RD-1's tolerance does not dispose of the case [F1][RD-1]. Code measured one off-route segment, 18:48–18:59, 7.35 km where the optimal route covers 2.38 km, and the billed excess is 5.54 km at $1.4099/km [F3][F4][RD-2]. Surge was 1.0×, so no surge element arises [F5].

The rider's only message before the segment was a reply to the driver's proposal: "可以，不要走 Clementi Avenue 2" — a yes to "another way" with one road ruled out [F7][F8]. That is general route consent with an excluded road, so the ground is general_route_consent with excluded_road = Clementi Avenue 2; the record shows that road was not among the roads driven on the segment, so the exclusion was honoured [F3][RD-5]. But a general "take another way" covers a route chosen to get there, not a driver's own errand. The segment drove a loop through Clementi West Street 1, Kent Ridge Crescent/Drive, Arts Link, Computing Drive and Heng Mui Keng Terrace — 7.35 km where the optimal stretch is 2.38 km — and no rider message asked for any of those places or roads; the only support for wider agreement is the driver's own after-the-trip statement, which is a claim and not consent [F3][F10][RD-5]. The segment therefore counts, not exempt.

RD-3 does not exempt it either: no rider-named stop appears in the chat and no stop is measured in the segment [F3][F8][RD-3]. The traffic screen found a reason on the replaced stretch (AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY, band 2, 18:25–18:59), so no driver violation is recorded under RD-4, and RD-4 does not exempt any kilometres — the amount turns only on whether the rider agreed [F11][F14][RD-4][RD-2].
